title: Hand won prospects to customer success without losing sales history
description:
As a customer-success owner I want won prospects retained as customers so the same history supports ongoing follow-up.

Feature: Customer success handoff
  Scenario: Continue follow-up after a sale
    Given a prospect in proposal with contact and sales history
    When it becomes a customer and gets a customer-success owner and follow-up
    Then the same Kanbus issue retains contact and sales metadata
    And the customer-success view shows the next follow-up after reload
